BiblicalUsage: Hadad is the name of a king of Edom who smote Midian, and of Hadad the Edomite whom God raised up as an adversary to Solomon, who had fled to Egypt as a boy and returned when David and Joab were dead.
TheologicalSignificance: God raises up adversaries against unfaithful kings — that is what I hold this name to show. Solomon's heart had turned, and the Lord did not leave him comfortable in it.
